caption: The drawing depicts a metal pan with an oval-shaped body, rendered in grayscale. The pan has high sides and is supported by three short, curved legs attached to the base. A long, narrow handle extends from one side of the pan, widening at the end with a rounded tip and a loop, suggesting it can be hung up. The handle is affixed at an angle rising upward from the main body. The surface texture of the pan shows some irregular shading, giving it a metallic, worn appearance. The background is plain and unadorned, with no additional objects or patterns. The artwork uses pencil or similar medium on an off-white paper background.
title: Ember Carrier
